description: Compare Japan ski areas with terrain facts, dated reports and explicit historical-season evidence.

tools.name: reports_get
tools.description: Read one dated report's base-level snow figures; new snow means since the previous report. Required: id. Returns the Report.

params.name: id
params.description: Exact dated report slug from source_url, e.g. hakuba-now-1st-october-2026.

tools.name: reports_list
tools.description: List latest regional report metadata from the public homepage without report narratives. Returns array of Report.

tools.name: resorts_get
tools.description: Inspect one exact canonical resort path with Japanese name, ability, lift and update-status facts. Required: id. Returns the Resort.

params.name: id
params.description: Canonical path suffix from a resort source_url, e.g. nagano-prefecture/hakuba-village/able-hakuba-goryu.

tools.name: resorts_list
tools.description: List source-owned national factual chart records through the bounded chart adapter. Returns array of Resort.

tools.name: seasons_list
tools.description: List confirmed historical season chart rows through the bounded chart adapter. Required: season. Returns array of Season.

params.name: season
params.description: Published completed season label YYYY-YYYY; both years must be consecutive.

novel_features.name: Resort tradeoff frontier
novel_features.description: Show nondominated resort choices for explicitly selected statistics.

novel_features.name: Historical trip-window intersection
novel_features.description: Intersect a past trip window with recorded first/last season spans.

novel_features.name: Municipality option portfolios
novel_features.description: Compare source-defined towns by known resort options and statistical ranges.

novel_features.name: Historical evidence coverage
novel_features.description: Find listed resorts with missing or ambiguous historical endpoint evidence.

novel_features.name: Saved-fact changes
novel_features.description: See factual field changes between the latest two locally captured observations.
